caption: The drawing depicts a figure resembling a doll or automaton with a porcelain-like face, rosy cheeks, and curly blonde hair, dressed in period clothing. The outfit includes a black jacket with white and pink ruffles, lace cuffs, and a pink patterned skirt with blue accents draped over the knees. The figure is wearing white stockings and black shoes. On the head is an ornate hat in light pink and blue, decorated with a feather or ribbon detail. The figure is seated on a tricycle with two large rear wheels with green spokes and a smaller front wheel, also with green spokes. With both hands, the figure is gripping metal bars that are attached to a large, metallic, teapot-shaped object on the front of the tricycle. There is also a large bell attached to the right rear wheel of the tricycle. The background is plain and beige, with a single line border framing the drawing.
title: Doll on Velocipede
